## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test` and (if `docs/` changed) `pnpm docs:build` pass.
- [ ] Changes to the data model, an invariant or a public interface update `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/zh/architecture.md`.
- [ ] User-visible changes update the English guide and its Chinese page (with `sourceHash`), or say here that a maintainer should add the translation.
- [ ] Test fixtures are synthetic: no real session logs, names, paths, prompts or secrets.
